title: Ceasefire GKG share leads JETS 3d
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] GDELT ceasefire GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads JETS log returns by 3 days (+) as ceasefire news lifts the whole airline basket, not just UAL; long JETS 3d [gdelt.gkg.ceasefire_share -> finance.JETS.log_return] (parent: R2-0059)
message: Weak support: r=0.06 (p=0.21, perm p=0.17, Bonferroni 1.0), best lag -3d r=0.13 sign as expected; long JETS z>1 1d hold: 29 trades, 52% hit, +23bp excess in-sample but OOS 14 trades 29% hit, -8bp avg. Not tradeable as-is.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.ceasefire_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long JETS next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] GDELT ceasefire GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads the JETS/SPY relative-strength ratio by 3 days (+): if ceasefire news moves airlines specifically rather than the whole market, the market-neutral spread should hold where raw JETS returns were in-sample only (OOS hit rate 29%); long JETS/short SPY 3d [gdelt.gkg.ceasefire_share -> finance.ratio.jets_spy] (parent: R2-0159)
